facts.text: Students at Penn State Berks can participate in Penn State's 2+2 program, beginning the first two years of a degree at Berks and completing the final two years at another campus, including University Park.

sources.title: First-Year Students - Penn State Berks
sources.quote: Penn State offers a unique 2+2 program that allows you to begin the first two years of any of the University's 275+ degrees at nearly any campus
